component.name: Simple ROM Organiser
component.summary: Match and organise ROM folders against TOSEC and No-Intro DATs

description.p: A small local web app that keeps the TOSEC and No-Intro DATs up to date, scans a ROM folder and builds a clean library: matched files are renamed and sorted, unwanted and duplicate files are set aside (never deleted), and M3U playlists are written for complete multi-disk sets. It also installs Kickstart ROMs for RetroArch/PUAE.
